name: Goodsteel Ledger
summary: The Goodsteel Ledger is a copy of a list kept in Searing Gorge. It names goods Krinkle Goodsteel wants brought to him in Gadgetzan.

sections.title: The Ledger
sections.body: Near an outhouse in Searing Gorge lies the Goodsteel Ledger, a copy meant for Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan. Its pages list goods he is seeking from several places. Carrying the ledger to him begins the search for what it names.

faq.answer: The Goodsteel Ledger is a copy of Krinkle Goodsteel's list of requested goods, found in Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Where do I find the ledger?
faq.answer: The Goodsteel Ledger lies by an outhouse in Searing Gorge.
Krinkle Goodsteel is a goblin in Gadgetzan who is looking for goods from Searing Gorge and other places.
The ledger lists Solid Crystal Leg Shafts, an Overdue Package, and Goodsteel's Balanced Flameberge.
Take the copy of the ledger to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan, then gather the goods listed in it.
